% 924-readline-typeset: verifies \readline lines from a self-generated file typeset in cmr10, against a static control box.
\input prelude
\font\myrm=cmr10
\chardef\rd=0
\chardef\wr=1
\immediate\openout\wr=ls924data.txt
\immediate\write\wr{first 123}
\immediate\write\wr{second 456}
\immediate\closeout\wr
\openin\rd=ls924data.txt
\readline\rd to\lnA
\readline\rd to\lnB
\message{924 A=\meaning\lnA}
\message{924 B=\meaning\lnB}
\closein\rd
\setbox0=\hbox{\myrm\lnA}
\setbox1=\hbox{\myrm\lnB}
\setbox2=\hbox{\myrm control zzz}
\lsshipbox0 \lsshipbox1 \lsshipbox2
\end
